## Problem
The owner of this repository cannot see how many visits each page had per day.

## Proposed Outcome
The service in this repository returns a daily visit summary per page.

## How Do We Know It Works
- A request for a page and a date returns the number of visits on that date.
- A date with no visits returns zero, never an invented number.

## Affected Users And Systems
- Users: the repository owner
- Systems: this repository only

## Constraints
- Counts come from recorded visits and are never invented.

## Open Questions
- None.

## Source
- Origin: idea from the repository owner
- Author: repository owner
